verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Google Cloud APIs can be called over REST or through client libraries, and that a REST reference exists for Billing. None of it documents a downloadable machine-readable spec (OpenAPI, discovery document, or equivalent) for Google Cloud's own APIs. API hub ingests API metadata from third-party gateways, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
